Cubo Solutions Limited.evidence: Cubo Solutions Limited is an active UK company based in Antrim that provides vehicle telematics and fleet management solutions according to Companies House and press releases. The company was acquired by Fuel Card Services in 2024 and officially rebranded alongside its parent company under the name Motia at the listed website in March 2025.

VANIR FLEET SERVICES LTD.evidence: The company's website displays its registered name VANIR FLEET SERVICES LTD, company number 16192767, and a headquarters address in Liverpool, UK. The website confirms they offer commercial fleet telematics, real-time asset tracking, and fleet management software systems.
